node: Grid transmission hardware and tower-line components
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one unusually direct US-listed niche hardware supplier, one diversified but obvious utility-hardware leader, and two underfollowed engineered-structure suppliers that sit adjacent to tower-line components. The cleanest underfollowed chokepoint candidate is Preformed Line Products because its public-company exposure maps directly to line hardware, fittings, anchoring, and transmission/distribution accessories. Hubbell is a reference leader rather than an alpha-discovery name because its Power Systems franchise is broad and well-known. Valmont and Arcosa are not fittings pure-plays, but their utility structures businesses are directly exposed to the same transmission buildout bill of materials and procurement cycle.
